narrative.overview: Prometheus is the annual printed sabermetrics abstract of League of Legends esports, in the line of Bill James's Abstract, Wisden and Baseball-Reference. Every page is set like a section of that book: running head over a double rule, a title in the text face, a lede, captioned tables and figures, and notes in the outer margin keyed by superscripts. The ground is warm uncoated paper and the type is real ink, with one spot ink (ledger blue) and four restrained league inks used only as marks and lines.
keyCharacteristics: One serif family (Source Serif 4) for everything, with old-style figures in prose, tabular lining figures in tables and true small caps for labels.
Booktabs registers with a light rule every fifth row and about 28px rows.
Ledger blue for state and reference only; league inks only as marks and lines.
Main column plus a 17rem margin for notes and caveats.
Small printed figures drawn from the data.
Rows re-rank in place as the one signature motion.

rules.name: The One Spot Rule
rules.body: Ledger blue marks state and reference, never decoration or a large fill.

rules.name: The League Mark Rule
rules.body: A league ink appears only as that league's mark or line.

rules.name: The Figure Rule
rules.body: Old-style figures in prose; lining tabular figures, right-aligned, wherever numbers are compared.

rules.name: The Small Caps Rule
rules.body: Labels use true small caps with light tracking, never faked uppercase.

rules.name: The Printed Page Rule
rules.body: No shadows, radius, gradients or textures.

dos: Do set comparable numbers in lining tabular figures with a true minus.
Do caption every table and figure in words that describe the current view.
Do key caveats to the margin with superscript marks.
Do keep rows near 28px with a light rule every fifth row.
donts: Don't add cards, radius, shadows, gradients or paper textures.
Don't use a league ink or ledger blue as a fill or for emphasis.
Don't put a label or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't animate anything other than the re-rank and the season switch.
